en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a riverside town. In the foreground, a paddle steamer is sailing on a wide river. Behind it rise terraced houses and, dominating the hill, a large castle-like complex with a Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires and steep roofs. The printed caption along the bottom identifies the scene. The overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.
